title: JollyTails Staff Assistant
description: AI-powered knowledge base for pet care operations using RAG and OpenAI embeddings. Consolidates fragmented SOPs into a searchable system with training tracking and admin analytics.

title: AI Showcase Site (This Site)
description: Portfolio and hiring evaluation system built with content-driven architecture. Demonstrates AI integration, systems thinking, and modern full-stack development.

title: Blackbird Brewing — Email Automation
description: Rebuilt a failing OpenAI email system around Claude Desktop + Gmail MCP. Parsed 1,049 real emails into a living knowledge base — Andy now handles 500+/month reviewing Claude drafts instead of rewriting them from scratch.

title: Coastal Ledger
description: 7-step mortgage wizard for Nova Scotia first-time homebuyers. Income, debts, lifestyle → full monthly cost breakdown with correct Canadian semi-annual compounding, CMHC insurance tiers, and OSFI B-20 stress testing.

title: Open Brain + Project Memory
description: Persistent memory layer for AI assistants — two MCP servers on Supabase backend. Open Brain captures thoughts with semantic search via pgvector embeddings. Project Memory tracks structured project state via CLAUDE.md files.

title: Sidequest
description: Multiplayer voice hangout app with 3D isometric rooms built in React Three Fiber. 23 procedural 3D furniture models, isometric orthographic camera, real-time multiplayer presence and seating via Supabase. Echo-cancelled voice via LiveKit WebRTC. Ships as a web app and Electron desktop build.

title: Gold River Homes Calculator
description: Modular home cost calculator for a Nova Scotia retailer. First-time buyers answer simple questions — the site provides the cost estimates. 9 categories with real NS market defaults (~$348K total), donut chart breakdown, monthly and bi-weekly payments.
